name: Sindhi Rasoi
summary: Comforting Sindhi home food: sai bhaji, koki and veggie-loaded kadhi.

foods.name: Sai Bhaji & Rice
foods.blurb: Spinach, dill and chana dal cooked with vegetables.

foods.name: Sindhi Kadhi
foods.blurb: Tangy besan and tamarind curry full of drumsticks and vegetables. No curd!

foods.name: Koki
foods.blurb: Thick, crispy flatbread with onion and pomegranate seeds.

foods.name: Aloo Tuk
foods.blurb: Double-fried smashed potatoes with masala. A sometimes side.
